armyRule.name: Martial Ka’tah
armyRule.body:
At the start of your Command phase, friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units with this ability are **[gloss:ac-readied:readied]**. While a friendly unit is **readied**, you can select one of the **[gloss:ac-katah-ability:ka’tah abilities]** presented below for that unit to use. If you do, that unit is no longer **readied**.

Each **ka’tah ability** will tell you when that **ka’tah ability** can be used, and the effects that **ka’tah ability** has on the unit using it.

We recommend placing a token next to each **readied** unit, removing it when that unit is no longer **readied**.

◈# Conversai
◈ WHEN | Your Command phase.
◈ TARGET | One friendly **readied** unit.
◈ EFFECT | Until the end of the turn:
▪ Being **[gloss:engaged:engaged]/[gloss:battle-shocked:battle‑shocked]** does not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-act:eligible to start an action]**.
▪ Starting an **[gloss:action:action]** does not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-shoot:eligible to shoot]**.

◈# Calistus
◈ WHEN | Your Movement phase, when a friendly **readied** unit is **[gloss:selected-to-move:selected to move]**.
◈ TARGET | That **readied** unit.
◈ EFFECT | When your unit makes a **[gloss:normal-move:normal]/[gloss:advance:advance]/[gloss:fall-back-move:fall‑back move]**, your unit can move through all types of model.

◈# Salvus
◈ WHEN | Your Shooting phase, when a friendly **readied** unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
◈ TARGET | That **readied** unit.
◈ EFFECT | Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
▪ **[gloss:ballistic-skill:BS].**
▪ **[gloss:hit-roll:Hit rolls]** and **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.

◈# Dacatarai
◈ WHEN | Start of the Fight phase.
◈ TARGET | One friendly **readied** unit.
◈ EFFECT | Your unit’s melee attacks that target an enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) can **[gloss:re-roll:re‑roll]** hit rolls of 1.

◈# Kaptaris
◈ WHEN | Start of the Fight phase.
◈ TARGET | One friendly **readied** unit.
◈ EFFECT | Melee attacks that target your unit have -1 to **hit rolls**.

◈# Rendax
◈ WHEN | Fight phase, when a friendly **readied** unit is** [gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.
◈ TARGET | One friendly **readied** unit.
◈ EFFECT | Your unit’s melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE].

**[gloss:ac-favoured-katah:Favoured Ka'tah]**

Many of the most prominent shield hosts favour a specific martial ka’tah above all others.

All **[gloss:detachments:detachments]** tagged ‘Unique: Shield Host’ state a Favoured Ka’tah. If you selected one of these **detachments**, the **ka’tah ability** that is the Favoured Ka’tah of that **detachment** grants the additional effect listed in that **detachment**.

Example: If you selected the Solar Watch **detachment**, when you select the Calistus **ka’tah ability** for a **readied** unit, that unit has +2" **[gloss:move-characteristic:M]** in addition to the normal effect of Calistus.

### Aegis of the Emperor
Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units with this ability have [core:Feel No Pain 5+] against **[gloss:mortal-wound:mortal wounds]**.

### Aquila Commander
At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

### Daughters of the Abyss
▪ Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units with this ability have [core:Feel No Pain 3+] against **[gloss:psychic-attack:psychic attacks]**.
▪ Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units with this ability have the following ability:

Psychic Null (Aura): Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units within 6" of this unit have [core:Feel No Pain 5+] against **psychic attacks**.

### Anathema Psykana
Though the Adeptus Custodes often fight alongside the Silent Sisterhood, they take orders only from their own commanders, or from the Emperor Himself.

You can include ANATHEMA PSYKANA units in your army, even though they do not have the ADEPTUS CUSTODES faction keyword.

When mustering your army, unless otherwise stated:
▪ You cannot select ANATHEMA PSYKANA as your **[gloss:army-faction:army faction]**.
▪ You cannot select an ANATHEMA PSYKANA model to be your WARLORD.

### Special Move Types
The following are special **[gloss:move-type:move types]** that certain or all of your units are eligible to make:
▪ **[gloss:shock-disembark-move:shock disembark move]** (18.07)

stratagems.restrictions: You cannot select the same unit as the target of this Stratagem more than once per battle round.

stratagems.name: Swift as the Eagle
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a **[gloss:normal-move:normal move]** of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: In Auramite clad
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (excluding CUSTODIAN WARDENS units).
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 **[gloss:armour-penetration:AP]** until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: Unlimited Endurance
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit ends an **[gloss:advance-move:advance move]**.
stratagems.effect:
Until the end of the turn:
▪ Your unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
▪ That **[gloss:advance-move:advance move]** does not prevent your unit from being **[gloss:eligible-to-charge:eligible to declare a charge]**.

enhancements.name: Bane of Abominations
enhancements.body: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model’s attacks that target an enemy CHARACTER/MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +1 to **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.

enhancements.name: Emperor’s Light
enhancements.body: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model has the following weapon:

enhancements.name: Castellan’s Mark
enhancements.body: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units. When doing so, you can set those units up in **[gloss:strategic-reserves:strategic reserves]**, regardless of how many units are already in **strategic reserves**.

enhancements.name: Eagle’s Eye
enhancements.body:
ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only.
▪ This model has +1 **[gloss:wounds:W]**.
▪ (Once per battle, per army) When attacks are allocated to this model, you can use this ability. If you do, this model has 3+ **[gloss:invulnerable-save:InSv]**.

rule.name: Wardens of the Dark Cells
rule.body:
While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) is within range of an **[gloss:objective:objective]**, melee attacks that target that unit with a **[gloss:strength:S]** greater than that unit’s **[gloss:toughness:T]** have -1 to **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.

**[gloss:ac-favoured-katah:Favoured ka’tah]**
◈# Kaptaris
◈ ADDITIONAL EFFECT | You can select one enemy unit **[gloss:engaged:engaged]** with your unit. That enemy unit must make a **[gloss:battle-shock-test:battle‑shock roll]**, with -1 to that **battle‑shock roll**. You cannot select the same enemy unit for this effect more than once per phase.

stratagems.name: Grim Responsibility
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: CHARACTER/MONSTER].

stratagems.name: No Escape
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall‑back move]**.
stratagems.target: One friendly **[gloss:unengaged:unengaged]** ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit that is within 6" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: **[gloss:declare-charge:Declare a charge]** with your unit. When selecting **[gloss:charge-target:charge targets]**, you can only select enemy units that made a **[gloss:fall-back-move:fall‑back move]** this phase and are within the **[gloss:maximum-distance:maximum distance]**.

stratagems.name: Indomitable Guardians
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit that is within range of an **[gloss:objective:objective]** and is **[gloss:eligible-to-fight:eligible to fight]**.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has [core:Fights First] and __must__ be the next unit you **select to fight**.

enhancements.name: Unstoppable Destroyer
enhancements.body:
ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. When this unit is selected to make a **[gloss:pile-in:pile‑in]/[gloss:consolidation:consolidation move]**:
▪ This unit can move up to 4".
▪ You can select any **[gloss:consolidation-mode:consolidation mode]** for that **consolidation move**, regardless of that **consolidation move**’s Before Moving restrictions.

enhancements.name: Genalchemic Warding
enhancements.body: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model has [core:Feel No Pain 5+].

rule.name: Silent Sisterhood
rule.body:
▪ When mustering your army, you can select a friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA CHARACTER model to be your WARLORD.
▪ Friendly PROSECUTOR SQUAD units have BATTLELINE.
▪ Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units have the following ability:

**Creeping Dread (Aura):** In the Battle‑shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, each enemy unit within 12" of this unit that is a PSYKER unit/below **[gloss:starting-strength:starting strength]** makes a **[gloss:battle-shock-test:battle‑shock roll]**, with -1 to that **battle‑shock roll**.

stratagems.name: Anathema Blademastery
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly VIGILATOR SQUAD unit is **[gloss:selected-to-fight:selected to fight]**.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s attacks have:
▪ [SUSTAINED HITS 1]
▪ __Or:__ [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: Psy‑chaff Volley
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PROSECUTOR SQUAD unit has shot.
stratagems.effect:
Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That unit is **[gloss:ac-prosecuted:prosecuted]** until the end of the turn:
▪ Attacks that target a **prosecuted** unit have +1 **[gloss:armour-penetration:AP]**.

stratagems.name: Purgation Sweep
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly WITCHSEEKER SQUAD unit is **[gloss:selected-to-shoot:selected to shoot]**.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s [TORRENT] attacks have:
▪ +1 **[gloss:attack-dice:A]**.
▪ __Or:__ If those attacks target a PSYKER/**battle shocked** unit, +2 **A**.

enhancements.name: Oblivion Knight
enhancements.body:
ANATHEMA PSYKANA model only. This unit’s attacks have:
▪ +1 to **[gloss:hit-roll:hit rolls]**.
▪ __Or:__ If this unit targets a PSYKER/**[gloss:battle-shocked:battle‑shocked]** unit, +1 to **hit rolls** and **[gloss:wound-roll:wound rolls]**.

enhancements.name: Huntress’ Eye
enhancements.body: ANATHEMA PSYKANA model only. In your Movement phase, you can select one **[gloss:visible:visible]** enemy unit within 12" of this unit. That unit makes a **[gloss:battle-shock-test:battle‑shock roll]**, with -1 to that **battle‑shock roll**.
